highlights: **Machine health and lighter background work:** Thread details can show CPU, memory and disk, with warnings when machines are overloaded or short on resources. Resource-history bucketing, checkpoint baseline reads, long-thread queries and pull-request sweeps do less work; mobile reduces idle socket traffic. These are implementation improvements, not measured fleet CPU or battery benchmarks.

**Agent reliability and explicit usage access:** Codex 0.171+ no longer receives duplicate T3 context after compaction. Restart recovery resumes agents after awaited shell cancellation, declined Codex changes remain declined, and ACP sessions can be re-imported after thread deletion. Usage-history and sign-in reads now ask for each agent's permission.

**Everyday workspace controls:** Snooze threads indefinitely, rename saved environments, draw on image attachments, select multiple side-panel tabs and attach a local folder from the composer. Boring sidebar folders show six threads with Show more/less; our project working/snooze controls and multi-project filter remain.

**Richer file handling:** Download chat and file-panel files, preview Markdown files and reply code blocks, unlock password-protected previews, and copy chat tables as PNG or aligned text. Many spreadsheet, notebook, EPUB, RTF, OpenDocument and PowerPoint fixes improve preview and attachment fidelity.

**Mobile and desktop polish:** Mobile gains configurable fonts, sharing a final response through the system share sheet and hiding viewed pull-request files; Android fixes keep undo notices clear of New thread. Desktop recovers connection catalogs after key loss, follows OS spellcheck languages on Windows/Linux, and preserves log backups when rotation cannot move the active file. Polish localization is added.

**Fork privacy and release safeguards retained:** Outbound analytics and diagnostic exporters remain disabled, including native SDK reporting; local collectors, resource history and Traces remain available. Upstream also uses renderer CDP for hardened desktop launch checks; our bounded logs, isolated Linux test home and safe shutdown safeguards remain.

**Availability is not activation:** Desktop and server releases are offered through the existing updater UI; no fleet server is restarted by publication. Android preview delivery remains an in-place APK update through the existing Syncthing folder, not proof of phone installation.
